title: To Know by the Company Words Keep and What Else Lies in the Vicinity

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring 'dissonance' directly in pre-training corpora by calculating the absolute difference of log-frequency ratios for various word dyads across the Bigger Analogy Test Set (BATS), encompassing inflectional, derivational, lexicographic, and encyclopedic relationships.

Constructing an intentionally biased Wikipedia corpus centered on UK cities and computing the frequency-ratio dissonance for 'UK city-county' analogies to demonstrate how statistical skew in training data impacts representational bias.
Evaluating the analogical dissonance of 'male-female' dyads from the BATS dataset by comparing the log-frequency ratios of the targeted words within specific text corpora.
Measuring statistical representation skew by calculating the analogical dissonance of 'name-nationality' word pairings from the BATS dataset directly in the training data.
